label: O Mandarin (Sichuan / Mandarin Chinese)
note: Five portrait pages (p1–5 of the PDF; p6 is a separate lunch menu, excluded). Every dish is printed in English with its Chinese name underneath in red; descriptions are pipe-separated ingredient lists. Section headings are bilingual ('Dim Sum 点心'). The restaurant name appears once, as the title over the Peking Duck panel on p2. Traps: the Chinese line under each dish is a translation, not a description and not a second dish; 'History and Serving' is prose, not a dish; Peking Duck has Half/Whole size lines; 'Or choice of …' protein lines are variants. The PDF text layer scrambles columns badly — pairings were taken from the rendered pages. Names and sections keep any Chinese as printed; the matcher compares Latin text only.
